mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name IN ('media_asset_application', 'media_asset_approval_log', 'media_application_definition', 'media_approval_config', 'mig_legacy_payment_application')) = 5 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = 'manual_task_execution' AND column_name IN ('action_code', 'action_name')) = 2

SELECT system_user.id, system_user.username, system_user.display_name AS displayName, system_user.real_name AS realName, system_user.phone, system_user.status, system_user.primary_department_id AS departmentId, department.dept_name AS departmentName FROM sys_user system_user LEFT JOIN sys_department department ON department.id = system_user.primary_department_id AND department.status = 1 AND department.deleted_at = 0 WHERE system_user.deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY system_user.id
SELECT id, channel_name AS channelName FROM media_channel WHERE id IN #{id} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0

SELECT definition.id AS definitionId, definition.application_name AS applicationName, config.id AS configId, CAST(config.form_schema AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS formSchema, CAST(config.nodes AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS nodes, config.approver_id AS configuredApproverId, config.approver_name AS configuredApproverName FROM media_application_definition definition INNER JOIN media_approval_config config ON config.id = definition.approval_config_id AND config.asset_type = 'PAYMENT' AND config.enabled = 1 AND config.deleted_at = 0 WHERE definition.application_code = 'PAYMENT' AND definition.status = 1 AND definition.deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY definition.id LIMIT 1
SELECT id, application_no AS applicationNo FROM media_asset_application WHERE application_no = #{applicationNo} AND deleted_at = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_asset_application ( application_no, asset_type, title, quantity, reason, status, requester_id, requester_name, department_id, department_name, approver_id, approver_name, decision_remark, decided_at, form_data, form_schema_snapshot, nodes_snapshot, current_node_index, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{candidate.applicationNo}, 'PAYMENT', '打款申请（历史迁移）', 1, LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{candidate.source.remark}), ''), '旧系统打款申请'), 1000), #{candidate.targetStatus}, #{candidate.requester.id}, #{candidate.requesterName}, #{candidate.requester.departmentId}, #{candidate.requester.departmentName}, #{candidate.auditor.id}, #{candidate.auditorName}, CASE WHEN #{candidate.targetStatus} = 'REJECTED' THEN LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{candidate.source.rejectReason}), ''), '旧系统已驳回'), 1000) ELSE NULL END, #{candidate.source.auditTime}, #{candidate.formData}, #{candidate.definition.formSchema}, #{candidate.definition.nodes}, #{candidate.currentNodeIndex}, #{candidate.requester.id}, #{candidate.auditor.id}, #{candidate.source.createdAt}, COALESCE(#{candidate.source.updatedAt}, #{candidate.source.auditTime}) )
